data.name: Muhammadiyah
data.gender_notes: Muhammadiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name inspired by the love for the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his teachings. The name Muhammadiyah carries the meaning “Follower of Muhammad” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhammadiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of muhammad and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the qualities of compassion, kindness, and devotion.
data.etymology: Muhammadiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Muhammad.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhammadiyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: محمدية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من اسم النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: محمدية اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من اسم النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، يعني التشبه به أو التبعية لسنة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأحيان للإشارة إلى الانتماء الفكري أو الروحي للنبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم.

in_urdu.name: محمدیہ
in_urdu.meaning: محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی نسبت سے مشتق
in_urdu.long_meaning: محمدیہ ایک علم مؤنث ہے جو رسول اللہ محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے نام سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ نام عموماً اس شخص کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو محمدی تعلیمات اور اقدار کی پیروی کرتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ شخص رسول اللہ کی سنت اور تعلیمات پر چلتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुहम्मदीयाह
in_hindi.meaning: नबी मुहम्मद की विशेषता या अनुसरण
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहम्मदीयाह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो नबी मुहम्मद के नाम से लिया गया है। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो नबी मुहम्मद की शिक्षाओं और मूल्यों का पालन करते हैं। यह नाम नबी मुहम्मद की विशेषताओं और उनके द्वारा स्थापित आदर्शों का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: محمديہ
in_pashto.meaning: د محمد نبي په نوم مشتق شوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: محمديہ يو مؤنث نوم دی چې د رسول الله محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم د نوم څخه اخيستل شوی دی. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کيږي چې د محمدي تعليماتو او ارزښتونو پيروي کوي.

in_english.name: Muhammadiyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from the name of Prophet Muhammad
in_english.long_meaning: Muhammadiyah is a female given name derived from the name of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). It signifies adherence to or association with the teachings, values, and legacy of Prophet Muhammad. The name reflects a deep spiritual connection to the Prophet and his exemplary character.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Muhammadiyah" holds great significance in the Islamic culture, as it is derived from the name of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), the last messenger of Allah. This name is not only a reminder of the Prophet, but also serves as a testament to the strong bond between the Muslims and their faith. The use of the name Muhammadiyah may be found throughout various Islamic organizations, institutions, and even entire communities, emphasizing the central place of the Prophet in the lives and hearts of Muslims.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name "Muhammadiyah" symbolizes the efforts of Muslims to uphold the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and revive and propagate the message of Islam in their daily lives. It represents the ongoing commitment to be modeled after the Prophet in his teachings and character, and striving to practice the virtues that he embodied such as compassion, generosity, patience, wisdom and fortitude. The name Muhammadiyah also signifies a pursuit of knowledge, for it was the Prophet who encouraged knowledge and learning, and prescribed it as a fundamental part of the Islamic faith. Ultimately, the name Muhammadiyah is a reminder of the prophetic legacy that provides Muslims with a sense of purpose, direction, and unity as they navigate their path toward righteousness and the pleasures of the hereafter.
